content.short: Sprout is an educational Web3 platform on BNB Chain that makes learning programming accessible and interactive.
content.description: Sprout, also known as Code Sprout, is a specialized educational platform built on the BNB Smart Chain dedicated to onboarding individuals into the world of programming and blockchain development. The platform employs a comprehensive three-part learning approach, combining structured text lessons, an integrated interactive code playground, and detailed video tutorials. By utilizing the SPROUT token, the project incentivizes learning and provides a decentralized framework for educational advancement. Sprout aims to lower the barrier to entry for aspiring developers, fostering a new generation of builders in the Web3 space.
